Each Booster Bundle contains 6 booster packs Each booster pack contains 10 additional game cards Product Description The hustle and bustle of the city turns into havoc as Mega Floette ex brings turmoil to the streets! Filled with courage and determination, Mega Greninja ex gathers other powerful Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, including Mega Pyroar ex and Mega Dragalge ex, to ward off this growing threat. As night falls, danger blossoms in the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion! Expand your collection with this Booster Bundle containing six booster pa cks from Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising! In-Depth Look Nightfall Over Lumiose City The bustle of metropolitan Kalos transforms into havoc as a mysterious energy surge sweeps through the streets of Lumiose City. This expansion invites you to navigate an urban landscape under siege, where the tactical defense of Mega Greninja ex must ward off the destructive turmoil of Mega Floette ex. Shop The Chaos Rising Collection The High Stakes of Mega Evolution Master the return of Mega Evolution with the high-risk, high-reward Unstable Evolution mechanic. Strategic Trainers must now weigh the power of a successful coin flip against the threat of self-inflicted damage, all while wielding the massive HP pools and devastating attacks of a new generation of Mega Pokémon ex. A Collector’s Urban Paradise With over 120 cards to discover, Chaos Rising features more than 35 Special Illustration Rares that capture the cinematic intensity of the Kalos region. From Mega Greninja ex blurring through rain-slicked streets to the somber history revealed in AZ’s Tranquility, every pack offers a chance to own a breathtaking piece of this metropolitan nightmare. A Legacy Thirty Years in the Making Celebrate Pokémon’s 30th anniversary with the First Partner Illustration Collection - Series 2, releasing as a special milestone after the Chaos Rising season. This collection honors the legacy of the Johto, Unova, and Galar starters, offering exclusive illustration rare promos that bridge thirty years of adventure with stunning new artwork. Partner Up with the Series 2 Collection Specs General Brand Name The Pokemon Company International Fandom FAQs Frequently Asked Questions What is the official release date for the Chaos Rising Booster Bundle? The Booster Bundle is scheduled for global release on May 22, 2026. How many booster packs are included in the Chaos Rising Booster Bundle? Each Booster Bundle contains six Chaos Rising booster packs. This product is specifically designed for players and collectors who want to focus on opening packs without the extra accessories found in an Elite Trainer Box What is the configuration of each individual booster pack? Every Chaos Rising booster pack contains 10 game cards, one Basic Energy card, and one Pokémon TCG Live code card. Which Pokémon is the mascot for the Chaos Rising expansion? The central mascot for this set is Mega Greninja ex. Other featured "Mega Evolution" Pokémon ex in the set include Mega Floette ex, Mega Pyroar ex, and Mega Dragalge ex. What are the "chase cards" available in Chaos Rising booster packs? Collectors are primarily searching for Special Illustration Rares (SIR), with the top targets being Mega Greninja ex (#114), Mega Floette ex (#115), and the AZ’s Tranquility Supporter card (#118). The set also features rare Gold Hyper Rare cards, such as Mega Greninja ex (#122). How does the new "Unstable Evolution" gameplay mechanic work? In Chaos Rising, Mega Evolving a Pokémon ex does not automatically end your turn. However, you must perform a coin flip: heads allows you to continue your turn normally, while tails causes the Mega Pokémon to take 50 damage and prevents you from attacking for the remainder of that turn. Does the Booster Bundle include a promo card or dice? No. Unlike the Elite Trainer Box, the Booster Bundle does not contain promotional cards, card sleeves, or dice. It is a streamlined product containing only sealed booster packs. How many cards are in the total Chaos Rising set? The set is based on the Japanese Ninja Spinner set and contains over 120 cards total. This includes a main set of roughly 83–86 cards and over 35 secret rares, such as Illustration Rares and Gold Hyper Rares. What other products are available in the Pokémon TCG: Chaos Rising and Mega Evolution series? The 2026 Mega Evolution series and the Chaos Rising expansion offer a variety of ways to collect and play, with products releasing in two waves: Launching May 22, 2026: Chaos Rising Elite Trainer Box: A premium toolkit for trainers that includes 9 booster packs, card sleeves, and essential gameplay accessories. Chaos Rising Booster Bundle Box: A streamlined box containing 6 booster packs, ideal for players focused on expanding their card collection. Chaos Rising Three-Booster Blister: A retail-exclusive pack featuring 3 booster packs and a special foil promo card, typically featuring Charmeleon. Chaos Rising Sleeved Booster Pack: Individual 10-card booster packs enclosed in a protective cardboard hangar sleeve to prevent tampering. Launching June 5, 2026: Pokemon Chaos Rising Build and Battle Box: Designed for prerelease-style play, this box contains a 40-card ready-to-play deck and 4 booster packs. Mega Moonlit Tin (Styles May Vary): A collector's tin featuring a powerful Mega Evolution Pokémon ex promo—either Mega Gengar ex or Mega Clefable ex—along with 4 booster packs. Lumiose City Mini Tin (Styles May Vary): Compact collectible tins that include 2 booster packs and an art card that combines with others to form a Lumiose City panorama.
